title: Historia creationis et transgressionis Adae (Armenian History of Creation)

details.intro:
The Historia creationis et transgressionis Adae is an independent Armenian apocryphal narrative detailing the creation of the world, the formation of Adam from seven substances, the deception by Satan disguised in serpent form, and the subsequent judgment.

Extant in two distinct recensions preserved in medieval Armenian miscellanies (Matenadaran collections), it was published by Sahak Yovsēp‘ianc‘ (1896) and critically re-edited with English translation by W. Lowndes Lipscomb (1990).
details.provenance:
Language: Classical Armenian.
Date: Translated/composed between the 5th and 10th centuries CE.
Recensions: Recension A and Recension B.
details.manuscripts: • Manuscripts: Erevan, Matenadaran MSS 1500 (dated 1271–1288 CE), 4618 (15th c.), 5967, and 7133.
